title: The Typo Tornado
subtitle: City names are a mess. Clean them up!
conceptSummary: SQL string functions: TRIM() removes spaces, UPPER()/LOWER() standardize case, REPLACE() fixes text.

dialogue.text: The e-commerce customer data has city names like 'mumbai', 'MUMBAI', ' Mumbai ' with spaces. It's chaos! GROUP BY won't work if the values differ.
UPPER() and TRIM(). Standardize the data. A good detective cleans the scene before drawing conclusions.

teachMoment.title: String Cleaning Functions
teachMoment.body:
Clean up text with:
• UPPER(city) → 'MUMBAI' (all caps)
• LOWER(city) → 'mumbai' (all lowercase)
• TRIM(city) → removes spaces from both ends
• REPLACE(name, 'old', 'new') → substitutes text

Example:
SELECT TRIM(UPPER(city)) AS clean_city FROM customers

task.instruction: Select customer name and city, but standardize city to UPPERCASE and TRIM any spaces. Sort by clean_city.
task.startingQuery:
SELECT name, TRIM(UPPER(city)) AS clean_city
FROM customers
ORDER BY clean_city

winDialogue.text: Clean data! Now GROUP BY city works perfectly. And I notice all SHADOW42 customers are from the same 3 cities.
Geographic clustering. This wasn't random fraud. It was a coordinated regional operation. Insight City will help us prove it.

storyBeat: Clean data reveals geographic patterns invisible in dirty data. The fraud is clustered. World 5: Insight City will help visualize and statistically prove this network's scope.
